headline: Develop Claude Code plugins with a comprehensive
short_description: End-to-end plugin development skill for Claude Code that scaffolds, creates, and validates plugins with support for commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP servers.
author: severity1

sections.overview:
Claude Code Plugin Creator provides comprehensive support for building Claude Code plugins, from initial scaffolding through distribution. It automates plugin creation across all five component types: commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP servers. The skill includes automation scripts, component templates, reference documentation, and a guided workflow to streamline development. Developers can quickly generate plugin structures, test locally using a pre-configured marketplace, and validate plugins before deployment. This skill is ideal for developers who want to extend Claude Code functionality without managing boilerplate setup manually.
Scaffold new Claude Code plugins with guided workflow and complete directory structure
Create and manage plugin components: commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP servers
Test plugins locally using the included dev-marketplace before production deployment
Validate plugin configuration and manifest files during development
This plugin allows users to analyze Salesforce data directly within Claude. It provides insights into customer interactions, sales trends, and performance metrics.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/severity1/claude-code-plugin-creator`
1. Download the plugin from the Claude Code repository
2. Install the plugin using the Claude Code CLI
3. Configure API credentials in the plugin settings
sections.usage:
